name: Nell Hart
description: A pincushion strapped to her wrist. Talks with her hands.

visits.greeting: Hello! I'm told you've a book with a mending charm in it. Stitch-something.

request.text: Common Wards and Small Mendings? For Stitch-Fast. I've forty hems to finish by Thursday.

readThoughts.default: Forty hems. Thursday. The Ashby wedding.

purpose.1: Hems. A whole wedding party, all in one week.

alternative.line: This one? Well — it's kind of you. I'll see.

offerRefused.line: Oh, I don't think that one's for sewing.

declined.line: Never mind. My thumbs will manage.

unhelpful.text: No mending charm in it, sadly, but thank you for trying. The hems got done, by thumb. — Nell

declined.text: Did you hear? The seamstress on Pin Lane sewed the whole Ashby wedding by candlelight. Four nights.
